title: 第17章 人阐截三教人丁兴旺青渊被打劫你知道你得罪的是谁吗第18章 大开杀戒整顿门风通天教主的允诺
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: “师弟，让我来说吧。”
看到无支祈面露不忿的表情。
云中子连忙出声道：“这些年来，我们玄门三教弟子也变得多了不少。”
“我们截教师祖又收了千数记名弟子，其中金箍仙、石矶、马元等修士名声显露，师祖还收了头只有一条腿的洪荒异兽奎牛为坐骑，我们截教弟子三千多人，十分热闹。”
当然。
说到热闹的时候。
云中子的表情显得有些怪异。
“嗯，继续说。”
青渊点了点头，云中子方才道：“二师伯近些年来也收了几名内门弟子，分别是惧留孙、慈航、太乙、普贤几人，还有个龙族来的黄龙道人献上九龙沉香辇闯过大阵，得入内门，除此外二师伯还收了头白鹤当道童。”
“该来的都来了啊。
青渊没有说话，内心感慨一声。
至于元始师伯收黄龙道人，并不意外。
黄龙道人乃龙族纯血真龙，又献上九龙沉香辇这种象征地位的宝物，与元始天尊有缘，自然能够拜入阐教。
只是……
阐教人多了，后面不会跟截教闹腾起来吧？
广成子、太乙、惧留孙这些可都不是什么好惹的主啊！
果然。
青渊余光看到无支祈面露不忿，似乎是有话要说，只是被云中子所阻拦罢了。
“嗯，还有吗？”
“大师伯收了两名外门弟子，一人名为真武，听说是人祖之一，另一人则是昆仑山散仙渡厄道人，除此外还收了两名童子为伴，以及一头青牛坐骑。”
云中子如实道来，让青渊有些愕然。
说实话。
他只知道后世真武大帝与人教有关，地位仅在四御之下，而实力是三界少有的强悍。
却没有想到。
这个时期便加入了人教？
两个童子应该是金角银角吧？渡厄真人也来了？
想至此，青渊内心止不住的叹气：人这么多，恐怕早晚有一场内战分家啊！
“我玄门人丁兴旺啊。”
青渊赞叹一声，看向无支祈道：“我看你有话要说，你想要说什么？”
“师父，你是有所不知，阐教的人实在是太恶了！”
无支祈怒气冲冲道：“一千年前我心血来潮外出遁入昆仑山水脉中修行，寻到一处天然岩洞，里处竟有数百万年方才凝练而出的天灵地髓心一簇，我等待数百年方才等到成熟，正当采摘方才一半，却被一个矮小敦胖的修士夺走大半，还要打我，说我湿生卵化怎得此造化。”
“我气不过，便仗着水中与他相斗，他斗不过我便土遁逃了，可谁知过了不久还带来帮手！”
“那帮手，不是别人，正是广成子、赤精子几人，那矮胖子看到我就说我偷他天材地宝，骂我是披毛戴角的畜生，然后广成子几人不分青红皂白便让我交出来，还说师父您教徒无法。”
“徒儿受辱倒没什么，但怎容他人污蔑师父的名声？”
“一怒之下，便与他们争斗起来，但抵不过这群金仙、玄仙，最终只能凭借江河逃离。”
云中子皱了皱眉，还是如实说道：“师父，这些年来随着阐教人多，也和我们截教起冲突的次数也越来越多。”
“两方大打出手闹得不可开交。”
“多宝师弟他们有将门规执行下去吗？”
青渊面色凝重。
“多宝师叔他们起初有将门规执行，开始还好，但后面师叔他们也要闭关修炼，门规便慢慢无人遵守，再加上我们截教大多为天地生灵得道，喜怒无常肆无忌惮，被阐教门人看不惯而争执，一来二去打出了火气，便抑制不住冲突了。”
云中子摇了摇头。
闻言。
青渊如何不知云中子是委婉了说呢？
截教现在还好，都是昆仑山范围来拜师的生灵。
content_en:
"Junior brother, let me speak."
Seeing Wu Zhiqi's expression of displeasure.
Yun Zhongzi hurriedly said: "Over the years, our disciples of the three Xuanmen religions have also become much more numerous."
"Our ancestor, Master Jie, has recruited thousands of registered disciples. Among them, monks such as Jin Guanxian, Shi Ji, and Ma Yuan have become famous. Our master has also accepted Kui Niu, a prehistoric beast with only one leg, as a mount. We have more than three thousand disciples, which is very lively."
Of course.
Speaking of lively times.
Yun Zhongzi's expression looked a little strange.
"Well, keep talking."
Qingyuan nodded, and then Yun Zhongzi said: "The second uncle has also accepted several inner disciples in recent years, namely, Wei Liusun, Cihang, Taiyi, Puxian, and a Huanglong Taoist from the Dragon Clan who presented a Nine Dragons Agarwood Chariot to pass through the formation and enter the inner gate. In addition, the second uncle also accepted a white crane as a Taoist boy."
“Everything that is supposed to come has come.
. "
Qingyuan didn't speak, and sighed in his heart.
As for Uncle Yuanshi accepting Taoist Huanglong, it was not surprising.
Taoist Huanglong is a pure-blooded true dragon of the dragon clan, and he also presented a status-symbolizing treasure such as the Nine-Dragon Agarwood Chariot. He is destined to be associated with Yuanshi Tianzun, so he can naturally worship the Chanjiao.
Just...
If there are too many people in the Chan sect, there won’t be any commotion with the Jie sect later, right?
Guangchengzi, Taiyi, and Weiliu Sun are not easy to mess with!
really.
From the corner of his eye, Qingyuan saw Wuzhiqi's expression showing dissatisfaction, as if he had something to say, but was blocked by Yun Zhongzi.
"Well, is there anything else?"
"Uncle Grand Master has taken in two outer disciples. One is named Zhenwu, who is said to be one of the human ancestors, and the other is a Sanxian Du'e Taoist from Kunlun Mountain. In addition, he has also taken in two boys as companions and a green bull mount."
Yun Zhongzi told the truth, which made Qingyuan a little stunned.
to be honest.
He only knew that the later Emperor Zhenwu was related to the Human Religion, his status was only below the Four Imperial Guards, and his strength was rare in the Three Realms.
But I didn't expect it.
Did you join the People’s Religion during this period?
The two boys should have golden horns and silver horns, right? Master Du'e is here too?
Thinking of this, Qingyuan couldn't help but sigh in his heart: There are so many people, I'm afraid there will be a civil war sooner or later to separate the family!
"My Xuanmen is prosperous."
Qingyuan sighed in admiration, looked at Wuzhi and prayed: "I see you have something to say, what do you want to say?"
"Master, you don't know something. The people who explain the teaching are really evil!"
Wuzhiqi said angrily: "A thousand years ago, I went out on a whim to practice in the water veins of the Kunlun Mountains. I found a natural cave. Inside, there was a cluster of the essence of heaven and earth that had been condensed for millions of years. I waited for hundreds of years for it to mature. When I was picking half of it, a short and plump monk took away most of it. He even beat me and said how I got this good fortune after being born in a wet egg."
"I couldn't get angry, so I fought him in the water. He couldn't fight him, so I ran away. But who knew he would bring help soon after?"
"The helpers were none other than Guangchengzi and Chi Jingzi. When the short fat man saw me, he said that I had stolen his talents and treasures, and called me a beast with hair and horns. Then Guangchengzi and the others asked me to hand it over indiscriminately. They also said that Master, you can't teach me."
"It's okay for my disciple to be humiliated, but how can we allow others to slander our master's reputation?"
"In anger, he started fighting with them, but he couldn't defeat these golden immortals and mysterious immortals. In the end, he could only escape by relying on the river."
Yun Zhongzi frowned, but said truthfully: "Master, as the number of people in Chan Cult has increased over the years, the number of conflicts with our Jie Cult has also increased."
"The two parties were fighting and it was a big deal."
"Junior Brother Duobao, have they implemented the sect rules?"
Qingyuan looked solemn.
"Uncle Duobao and the others enforced the sect rules at first, which was fine at first. But later on, the sect members also had to practice in seclusion, and gradually no one followed the sect rules. In addition, most of our Jiejiao disciples are trying to gain enlightenment for the world's creatures. They are moody and unscrupulous. The disciples of the Chanjiao disciples couldn't stand it, so they argued. They got angry over and over again, and they couldn't suppress the conflicts."
Yun Zhongzi shook his head.
Hear the words.
How could Qingyuan not know that Yun Zhongzi was speaking euphemistically?
Jie Jiao is doing well now, they are all creatures from the Kunlun Mountains who come to be their disciples.
